item.title: Caley Thistle to Face Raith Rovers in KDM Evolution Trophy Final
item.description: Inverness Caledonian Thistle will face Raith Rovers in the 2025 26 KDM Evolution Trophy final at Firhill on 5 April, with £150,000 and national silverware on the line in a live BBC ALBA broadcast.The post Caley Thistle to Face Raith Rovers in KDM Evolution Trophy Final appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: West Highlands Seafood Delivery Firm Backed by Highland Loan Fund
item.description: A seafood delivery business serving Skye and Lochalsh has secured loan support from Highland Opportunity Investments Limited, helping protect a trusted West Highlands route while investing in digital ordering and future growth.The post West Highlands Seafood Delivery Firm Backed by Highland Loan Fund appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: The Boot That May Name The Woman Found off Iona
item.description: Police have released an image of a rare Meindl walking boot as they continue efforts to identify a woman found in the water west of Iona on 23 September 2025, hoping the distinctive footwear may spark recognition.The post The Boot That May Name The Woman Found off Iona appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Rethinking Childcare for Highland’s Remote Communities
item.description: Highland Council is developing new approaches to early learning and childcare, aiming to deliver flexible provision for remote and rural communities while tackling workforce pressures and child poverty across the region.The post Rethinking Childcare for Highland’s Remote Communities appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Family Pay Tribute To Naomi MacIvor After Dornoch Tragedy
item.description: Naomi MacIvor, 46, has been named as the woman who died at a property in Dornoch on 21 February 2026, as her family pay tribute and a man appears in court in connection with her death.The post Family Pay Tribute To Naomi MacIvor After Dornoch Tragedy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: From Oyster Farms to Island Pontoons as £123,000 Boosts Grassroots Environmental Projects
item.description: Nine environmental projects across Scotland have shared £123,000 from Crown Estate Scotland, backing grassroots work from oyster waste recycling in Argyll to replacing a vital conservation pontoon in Highland.The post From Oyster Farms to Island Pontoons as £123,000 Boosts Grassroots Environmental Projects appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highlands and Islands Alba Members Vow to Fight on After Emergency Meeting
item.description: Alba Party members in the Highlands and Islands have voted to fight on and seek a members ballot after an emergency meeting amid uncertainty over whether the party will contest the May 2026 Scottish Parliament election.The post Highlands and Islands Alba Members Vow to Fight on After Emergency Meeting appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Green Freeport Projects Secure UK Funding Boost for Highland Growth
item.description: Two Inverness and Cromarty Firth Green Freeport sites have secured UK Government funding to unlock development and jobs, supporting environmental studies and planning work aimed at driving long-term investment in the Highlands.The post Green Freeport Projects Secure UK Funding Boost for Highland Growth appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: £100,000 of Cocaine Seized on A9 Near Crubenmore
item.description: Two people have been arrested after cocaine worth an estimated £100,000 was seized during a vehicle stop on the A9 near Crubenmore, with police highlighting the impact of drug supply on Highland communities.The post £100,000 of Cocaine Seized on A9 Near Crubenmore appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Scottish Leaders Respond to US and Israel Strikes on Iran
item.description: First Minister John Swinney and Scottish Greens MSP Patrick Harvie have issued statements following US and Israeli strikes on Iran, urging de-escalation and warning of the risks of a widening regional conflict.The post Scottish Leaders Respond to US and Israel Strikes on Iran appeared first on The Highland Times.
